dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: This is a nice workshop. Looks like I will be able to continue my research here as well.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Hmm, I believe that you must have acquired some sort of secret art that allows you to copy things from the real world, is this not so?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, I'd like to conduct some further research with you. Perhaps it may be of some help to you.
